svg.title: Core Equality And Comparison
svg.desc: A left-right comparison graphic showing 7 Ligconsolata Next samples. The left side is shaped from a smoke-built font with liga, dlig, and calt enabled, and the right side is the same raw ASCII source with ligatures disabled.
svg.text: Default equality and comparison forms stay width-preserving and visually distinct.
默认相等与比较符保持等宽，并清楚区分两横线和三横线。

g.text: <= and >= are comparison glyphs, not arrow glyphs.
<= 和 >= 是比较符，不按箭头逻辑处理。
== / != 保持两条横线；=== / !== 保持三条横线。
